verdicts.rationale: Independent reproduction confirms REST v2 /entities/search accepts invalid ef=0 in searchParams and returns HTTP 200 instead of 400 error. Source code analysis proves generateSearchParams() performs no parameter validation - only string formatting. HNSW index contract requires ef >= 1 (client/index/hnsw.go:hnswEfKey), but REST API layer enforces no such constraint. Matches developer cognition pattern: REST v2 parameter validation is a known blindspot area. This is a genuine Type1_IllegalSuccess defect - API succeeds with invalid input that should be rejected.
